subtitle: The language of research, and prepositions only found in writing
words.intro: German research doesn’t say *I think*. There’s a passive form for it: *Es ist davon auszugehen*. Nor does it say *because of*. It has *aufgrund*, *kraft* and *mangels*. Whole careers have been built on writing a paper in which nobody does anything at all.

grammar[0].blocks[2].title: The talk turns on three signposts
grammar[0].fact: A talk in German has signals, and listeners wait for them: *Zunächst*, *Im Folgenden*, *Abschließend*. If you miss them, it can sound as though no one’s in charge. The same word at the same point, each time, is not a bad style here. It’s considered manners.

grammar[1].fact: Most of these aren’t in anyone’s speech, and you won’t ever need to say them. What you do need is not to be stopped when you see them in a contract. *Vorbehaltlich* is one of the most expensive words in German: it’s where the *but* is hidden.

document.intro: A real questionnaire used to work out what a family lost. A house at *Hutberg 29*, in the Sudetenland: when it was built, how many windows, whether it had a cellar. You will see only one handwritten note about the owner. *1947 verstorben*.
document.fact: After 1952, West Germany’s *Lastenausgleich* paid compensation to those who had lost property in the war and the expulsions.

reading.title: Die teilnehmende Beobachtung
reading.intro: A sociologist from the university, Frau Dr. Kessler, has been studying *social control in inner-city courtyards*. She’s spent two years at a rented window at Hofstraße 12, with a questionnaire and binoculars. Today she’s presenting her findings at a conference. Max has come with Frau Huber, who has asked to sit at the front.
reading.photos[1].caption: Ein Institutsgebäude: Mangels Fenster wird hier nichts beobachtet.
reading.fact: German academic writing does have a real rule against *ich*, though it’s been loosening for some time. A German doctor’s title is a matter of real prestige, and some politicians have lost their posts over a doctoral thesis found to be copied. Volunteers on the internet have been checking for years.
